usedFor: SuperSaaS holds appointments, and Calendly offers a one-time meeting through “Create One-Time Meeting” after “New Appointment”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new appointment opens a single meeting in Calendly.

watchOut: “Appointment Changes” fires on creates, edits and deletes, so “Create One-Time Meeting” can run for a deleted booking.
